reports.title: TE Connectivity delivers 12% sales increase and over 20% EPS growth in fiscal fourth quarter

lines: With strong orders across our businesses, we expect first quarter sales to be up mid-teens and to deliver more than 20 percent EPS growth year over year.
For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company expects sales of approximately $5.35 billion, up 15% on a reported and organic basis year over year.
